setup: Each picture is the LCD of the author's Octatrack MKI (OS 1.40C, a development twin 4b375949 of Modwerk base 0.7.5 with this version as the PERSONALIZE table owner, RAM-booted; imageSha256 is that twin's MAIN image) with the development session's png step on 16 November 2026, with this version's release package d460c7e2 installed. 256x128, the 128x64 LCD at integer scale 2, two grey levels, not edited. The author navigated by hand: FUNC + MIXER (PROJECT), DOWN to SYSTEM, RIGHT, DOWN to PERSONALIZE, YES, DOWN to MUTE MODE.
